# Mega UI

> React 19.2+ + TypeScript component library styled from measured Toss (TDS) values. SCSS with CSS-variable
> tokens, qrcode-generator for QR encoding, Korean-first documentation. Version 0.1.0, 197 named exports covering the 150-component checklist.

## Required UI writing contract

Before generating UI, read [UX writing](./ux-writing.md) and [AI guide](./ai-guide.md).
All user-facing copy and accessible names MUST follow this contract. Run the supplied
[copy checker](./check-ux-writing.mjs) in the consumer CI and complete the semantic checklist.
Installing this package alone does not configure a consumer project’s AI instructions or CI.

## Components

- [Readiness](./readiness.md): Selection validation, date bounds, tab relationships, toast handles, signed charts, failure recovery and browser checks.

- Layout: Container, Stack, Grid
- Typography: Heading, Text
- Controls: Button, IconButton, Chip, Input, Textarea, Select, Checkbox, Radio, Field
- Forms: AutoComplete, CheckboxGroup, DatePicker, FloatLabel, IconField, IftaLabel, InputColor, InputGroup, InputMask, InputNumber, InputOtp, InputPassword, InputTags, KeyFilter, Knob, Label, Listbox, Rating, Slider, ToggleButton
- Form aliases: InputText (Input), RadioButton (Radio), ToggleSwitch (Switch), ToggleButtonGroup (SegmentedControl)
- Surfaces: Card, Badge, Alert, Separator, PageHeader
- Patterns: ListRow, Switch, SegmentedControl, BottomCTA, ProgressBar, Result
- Navigation: Tabs, TabPanel, SideNav, SideNavSection, SideNavItem, NavRail, NavRailItem, TopBar, TopBarLink, Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbItem, Pagination
- Overlay: Dialog, Menu, MenuItem, MenuSeparator, MenuLabel, Tooltip, ToastProvider, useToast
- Data: Table, TableHead, TableBody, TableRow, TableHeaderCell, TableCell, TableEmpty, Stat, Amount, Avatar, AvatarGroup, Skeleton, Banner, EmptyState

## Important

Import components from @mega-ui/react and CSS once from @mega-ui/react/styles.css.
Theme by overriding base palette variables (e.g. --mega-blue-600) or the theme-independent semantic
variables (e.g. --mega-brand, --mega-muted); dark mode is `data-mega-theme="dark"`.
useToast requires a ToastProvider ancestor. Dialog is controlled via `open` and `onClose`.
The package has not been published to a registry. Use the locally packed tarball for evaluation.
Do not invent undocumented exports or props. This index is documentation, not an MCP endpoint.
